claims: Obtain blood cultures and additional diagnostic specimens to evaluate suspected infection, given leukocytosis (WBC up to 27.9 K/uL) and ongoing antibiotics.
Continue broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy (levofloxacin, metronidazole, oral vancomycin) and reassess response.
Monitor hemodynamics closely given hypotension (systolic 89–99 mmHg, MAP 62–67 mmHg) and tachycardia (HR 100–103 bpm).
Assess and manage pain with the currently available analgesic regimen, reassessing pain scores.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status on 4 L/min nasal cannula; titrate oxygen to maintain SpO2 above desaturation limit.
Monitor serum electrolytes and renal function, including sodium (128–133 mEq/L), bicarbonate (18–20 mEq/L), and creatinine (0.8–0.9 mg/dL).
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (9.3–10.2 g/dL / 28.7–32.3%) and assess for bleeding or need for transfusion.
Implement fall precautions and maintain bed rest given high fall risk and bedfast status.
Perform oral care and dysphagia screening given mildly impaired swallow and oral cavity findings.
Monitor lactate trend (1.5–2.4 mmol/L) and perfusion status.
